records.title: Magic Downpour
records.description:
Magic Downpour is a spell in Elden Ring. Creates a magical orb slightly above your head which then randomly fires weak bolts down in a cone pattern. The bolts are not guided to nearby enemies, so the accuracy of the attacks (and therefore efficiency of the damage output) is extremely limited against all but the largest enemies that may be hit by a large number of the bolts.
It is one of the Carian Blade Sorceries, a subset of the Carian Sorceries.

stats.Effect: Summon a magic mass that sprays projectiles over area
